title: The coincidence set of two continuous maps into a Hausdorff space is closed
statement: Let $T$ and $H$ be topological spaces with $H$ Hausdorff (any two distinct points have disjoint open neighbourhoods), and let $a,b:T\to H$ be continuous maps. Then the set $\{t\in T: a(t)=b(t)\}$ is closed in $T$.
